Create a Department and Assign a Manager

User manual · English · 10 steps
Learn how to add a department to the company structure: name it, choose its manager and parent department, and save it.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Departments

Click Departments.

3. New department

Click New to create a department.

4. Department name

Type the department's name, then press Tab.

5. Search Manager

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

6. Choose the manager

Click the result you want in the list.

7. Search Parent Department

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

8. Choose the parent department

Click the result you want in the list.

9. Save

Click the save icon to keep the department.

10. Department saved

The department is saved. Click its name to finish.
